# platform-orchestrator_role (Data Source)

Looks up an organization role by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_role" "viewer" {
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The role UUID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the role was created.
- `created_by` (String) The UUID of the user that created the role.
- `display_name` (String) The role's display name.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether this is an immutable built-in role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) The granular permission identifiers assigned to the role.
